Title: Seller marks an active listing as Sold from the listing page
Preconditions: User is logged in as the seller and has an active listing in Available status.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the active listing page.
2. Click the 'Mark as Sold' button.
3. Confirm the action if prompted.
Expected Result: Listing status updates to 'Sold' on the listing page, and an option to undo/relist becomes available.

Title: Sold listing is excluded from search results
Preconditions: A listing has just been marked as 'Sold' by the seller.
Steps:
1. Log in as a buyer or browse as a guest.
2. Search for the listing using its exact title and category filters.
Expected Result: The sold listing does not appear anywhere in the search results.

Title: Existing chat participants see 'Sold' badge after listing is marked sold
Preconditions: Buyer A had an existing chat thread about the listing before it was marked sold.
Steps:
1. Seller marks the listing as 'Sold'.
2. Log in as Buyer A.
3. Open the chat list and navigate into the chat thread for that listing.
Expected Result: A 'Sold' badge is displayed on the listing header/preview inside the chat thread and inbox.

Title: Seller undoes 'Sold' status when a deal falls through
Steps:
1. Navigate to the sold listing page as the seller.
2. Click 'Undo Sold' / 'Mark as Available'.
3. Search for the listing as a buyer and check existing buyer chats.
Expected Result: Listing reverts to 'Available' status, reappears in search results, and the 'Sold' badge is removed from existing chats.
